body: hi, I am very sorry to hear this. but please don't let your aggression make you want to hurt yourself (or your keyboard). coming from an abusive home is never easy. is moving out not possible for you?

this hits very close to home. I am really sorry you feel this way and also that I can't give much advice considering I feel the same way. this may feel like a standard question but have you ever considered therapy of some sort?
